charms.name: Adrenaline Burst
charms.effect: Bursts of adrenaline enhance your reflexes with a 6% / 9% / 12% chance after getting hit and lets you move faster for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Bless
charms.effect: Blesses you and reduces skill and XP loss by 6% / 9% / 12% when killed by the chosen creature.

charms.name: Carnage
charms.effect: Killing a monster has 10% / 20% / 22% chance to deal Physical Damage equal to 15% of its maximum health to all monsters in a small radius.

charms.name: Cleanse
charms.effect: Cleanses you from within with a 6% / 9% / 12% chance after you get hit and removes one random active negative status effect and temporarily makes you immune against it.

charms.name: Cripple
charms.effect: Cripples the creature with a 6% / 9% / 12% chance and paralyses it for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Curse
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Death Damage once.

charms.name: Divine Wrath
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Holy Damage once.

charms.name: Dodge
charms.effect: Dodges an attack with a 5% / 10% / 11% chance, taking no damage at all.

charms.name: Enflame
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Fire Damage once.

charms.name: Fatal Hold
charms.effect: Your attacks have a 30% / 45% / 60% chance to prevent creatures from fleeing due to low health for 30 seconds.

charms.name: Freeze
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Ice Damage once.

charms.name: Gut
charms.effect: Gutting the creature yields 6% / 9% / 12% more creature products.

charms.name: Low Blow
charms.effect: Adds 4% / 8% / 9% critical hit chance to attacks with critical hit weapons.

charms.name: Numb
charms.effect: Numbs the creature with a 6% / 9% / 12% chance after its attack and paralyses the creature for 10 seconds.

charms.name: Overflux
charms.effect: Each attack has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to deal Physical Damage equal to 2.5% of your maximum mana.

charms.name: Overpower
charms.effect: Each attack has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to deal Physical Damage equal to 5% of your maximum health.

charms.name: Parry
charms.effect: Any damage taken has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to be reflected to the aggressor as Physical Damage.

charms.name: Poison
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Earth Damage once.

charms.name: Savage Blow
charms.effect: Adds 20% / 40% / 44% critical extra damage to attacks with Critical Hit weapons.

charms.name: Scavenge
charms.effect: Enhances your chances to successfully skin/dust a skinnable/dustable creature by 60% / 90% / 120%.

charms.name: Vampiric Embrace
charms.effect: Adds 1.6% / 2.4% / 3.2% Life Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides life leech.

charms.name: Void Inversion
charms.effect: 20% / 30% /40% chance to gain mana instead of losing it when taking Mana Drain damage.

charms.name: Void's Call
charms.effect: Adds 0.8% / 1.2% / 1.6% Mana Leech to attacks if wearing equipment that provides mana leech.

charms.name: Wound
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Physical Damage once.

charms.name: Zap
charms.effect: Each attack on a creature has a 5% / 10% / 11% chance to trigger and deal 5% of its maximum Hit Points as Energy Damage once.
